title: Turner's virtual reality scenarios in abductions

tellings.quote: She referred to what something she described as virtual reality scenarios,

plain: Tim Alberino, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels about alien abduction stories, mentions a woman named Karla Turner. According to Alberino, Turner described what she called "virtual reality scenarios" in these experiences. The point, if true, is that what abductees remember may be staged illusions put into their minds rather than real events.
